headline: US clears Hormuz mines, Oman mediates interim shipping corridor amid Iran sanctions
subheadline: Trump announced via Truth Social that US Navy cleared all mines in Strait of Hormuz, warning Iran any new mines would be destroyed immediately.
lede: US forces have cleared or exploded all mines in the Strait of Hormuz international waters, following direct threats to Iran and a warning from Trump that any new mines would be destroyed. Iran and Oman have moved toward an interim shipping corridor agreement, with joint de‑mining talks potentially paving the way for US‑Iran negotiations, while Iran’s currency has plunged to 205,000 tomans per dollar and gold reached 224 million tomans after new sanctions. Israeli forces struck five Hamas weapons storage facilities and a launch site across multiple strikes in Gaza, locating rockets, explosives and combat gear inside mosques beside humanitarian infrastructure, and IDF Chief of Staff visited combat troops for operational assessments. Russian forces launched simultaneous ballistic missile threats from Taganrog, Sumy and Kursk, including Iskander‑M and Zircon hypersonic missiles, while Ukrainian long‑range drones hit a Wildberries sorting center in Kotovsk, and Ukraine received Patriot missiles, AIM‑120 AMRAAM and Crotale air‑defence systems.

sections.title: Russian missile barrages target northern Ukraine
sections.body: Russian forces launched ballistic missile threats from Taganrog (Iskander‑M), Sumy (Zircon) and Kursk, targeting Chernihiv, Poltava and Sumy/outskirts. Ukrainian long‑range drones struck a Wildberries sorting center in Kotovsk, Tambov region, causing a massive fire. Russian sources claim no motivated AFU units remain in Sumy and Kharkiv directions, while Ukraine received a small batch of Patriot missiles, AIM‑120 AMRAAM and several Crotale air‑defence systems. CIA Director Ratcliffe visited Moscow during the deliveries.

sections.title: Israel strikes Hamas weapons sites in Gaza
sections.body: IDF and Shin Bet destroyed five Hamas weapons storage facilities and a launch site across multiple strikes in Gaza, seizing rockets, arms, explosives, grenades and combat equipment stored inside mosques beside humanitarian infrastructure. IDF Chief of Staff completed a visit to the Gaza Strip, meeting combat troops and conducting operational assessments with sector commanders. US forces cleared or exploded all mines in the Strait of Hormuz international waters after Iranian threats, with Trump warning any new mines would be destroyed immediately. Iran and Oman have moved toward an interim shipping corridor agreement, planning joint de‑mining and technical talks for permanent corridor management.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The simultaneous de‑mining of the Strait of Hormuz and the interim shipping corridor agreement signal a tentative de‑escalation between the US and Iran, though Iranian threats of countermeasures and currency freefall indicate lingering instability. Russia’s coordinated ballistic missile campaign from multiple launch sites, coupled with Ukrainian long‑range strikes on Russian logistics hubs and new Western air‑defence deliveries, reflects an intensifying ISR‑strike cycle across both fronts.
